ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) with a macro-ratio of approximately 7:1 relative to high-intensity (white) markings visible on the distal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous black region covering 85% of the visible surface. Dense cluster of high-contrast white curvilinear and linear segments on the distal left lobe. Small, isolated high-contrast white markings (hook and line shapes) on the distal right lobe tip. Sparse white mottling along the central trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped depression with an estimated interior angle of 135 degrees and a shallow bounding-box depth relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the left lobe trailing edge. More irregular, higher-amplitude jagged peaks and valleys along the right lobe trailing edge, including several distinct 'teeth'.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the trailing edges of both lobes, tapering to pointed distal tips with a slight upward sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small high-contrast white circular clusters at the distal tip of the right lobe and scattered along the trailing edge of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Significant parallel white linear tracks (rake marks) on the left distal tip. Distinct geometric white scars resembling the character '7' and an 'X' on the upper surface of the right distal lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced white rake mark scarring on the distal left lobe. Distinctive 'X' and '7' shaped white scars on the distal right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Intricate, filigree-like network of white pigment lines on the outer third of the left lobe's ventral surface.
